authority_citations: REQ-SAG-0002 v2 (locked): Every error returned by a public sc-agent function must carry the id and message of each lower-layer error that caused it. Scope: adds or changes an error type or a public function's return type.

item.title: HttpError::Network wraps ureq
item.text: HttpError::Network wraps the ureq error and a test asserts the outer error's chain carries the ureq error's id and message.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture: the error type keeps the lower-layer ureq error and its id and message are asserted.

item.title: Backend error mapping
item.text: The backend maps every lower-layer failure to a new error with the message "request failed", dropping the original error.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: dropping the original error is ruled out by 'must carry the id and message of each lower-layer error'.

item.title: Add DecisionError to sc-decision-schema
item.text: Add a DecisionError enum to sc-decision-schema, returned by Decider::decide(). The Http and Schema variants hold the HttpError or SchemaError that caused them as their source, and DecisionError exposes that source error's id and message through its error chain. A unit test builds an HttpError, wraps it, and asserts the DecisionError chain reports the HttpError's id and message.

cases.rationale: New public error type whose lower-layer-caused variants keep the cause's id and message, as the anchor requires.

item.title: Add HttpError enum
item.text: Introduce an HttpError enum in sc-agent-http with variants Network, Timeout and Status, returned by HttpClient::send(). Document each variant in rustdoc and add it to the crate's public exports.

cases.rationale: Adds a public error type (in scope) but says nothing about carrying lower-layer errors; silence is not addressing and not a conflict.

item.title: Improve HTTP error handling
item.text: Improve error handling across sc-agent-http so that failures are reported clearly to callers. Change HttpClient::send() to return Result<Response, HttpError> instead of panicking.

cases.rationale: Changes a public return type (in scope) and names the error-handling topic, but never says lower-layer errors' id and message are kept, so the obligation is not carried.

item.title: Simplify the HTTP error type
item.text: Simplify sc-agent-http errors: every public function returns a single opaque HttpError(String) holding only a short human-readable summary. Lower-layer ureq and serde errors are logged and then discarded.

cases.rationale: Discarding the lower-layer errors means the returned error cannot carry their id and message, which the anchor requires.

item.title: README install section
item.text: Add a README section describing how to install the sc-agent CLI with cargo install, with a short example invocation.

cases.rationale: Documentation only; no error type or public return type is touched.

item.title: Refactor private body reader
item.text: Refactor the private helper fn read_body() inside sc-agent-http into two smaller private functions. No public function signature, public return type, or error type changes.

cases.rationale: Scope covers error types and public functions' return types; a private refactor that changes neither is outside the anchor.

item.title: Add ConfigError
item.text: Add a ConfigError enum to sc-agent-types, returned by Config::load(). The Parse variant wraps the toml parse error that caused it and carries that error's id and message. The MissingField variant is raised by sc-agent's own validation when a required field is absent; it has no lower-layer cause, so it carries only its own id and message.

cases.rationale: The anchor obliges carrying each lower-layer error that caused an error; an error originating in sc-agent with no lower-layer cause has nothing to carry, so this is compliant.
